title: Forecasting Natural Gas Prices in Real Time
abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of the forecastability of the real price of natural gas in the United States at the monthly frequency considering a universe of models that differ in their complexity and economic content. Our key finding is that considerable reductions in mean-squared prediction error relative to a random walk benchmark can be achieved in real time for forecast horizons of up to two years. A particularly promising model is a six-variable Bayesian vector autoregressive model that includes the fundamental determinants of the supply and demand for natural gas. To capture real-time data constraints of these and other predictor variables, we assemble a rich database of historical vintages from multiple sources. We also compare our model-based forecasts to readily available model-free forecasts provided by experts and futures markets. Given that no single forecasting method dominates all others, we explore the usefulness of pooling forecasts and find that combining forecasts from individual models selected in real time based on their most recent performance delivers the most accurate forecasts.
abstract_zh: 本文以月度频率，对美国天然气实际价格的可预测性进行了全面分析，所考虑的模型集合在复杂程度和经济内涵上各不相同。我们的核心发现是，在实时条件下，对于长达两年的预测期限，相较于随机游走基准，均方预测误差可实现相当大的降低。一个特别有前景的模型是包含六个变量的贝叶斯向量自回归（VAR）模型，该模型纳入了天然气供需的基本决定因素。为刻画这些变量及其他预测变量的实时数据约束，我们从多个来源整理了一个包含历史版本（vintage）的丰富数据库。我们还将基于模型的预测与专家和期货市场提供的现成无模型预测进行了比较。鉴于没有任何单一预测方法能够优于所有其他方法，我们探讨了预测组合的效用，发现依据近期表现在实时条件下选出的各个模型预测的组合，能够提供最准确的预测。

title: A General Approach to Recovering Market Expectations from Futures Prices With an Application to Crude Oil
abstract: Futures markets are a potentially valuable source of information about market expectations. Exploiting this information has proved difficult in practice, because the presence of a time-varying risk premium often renders the futures price a poor measure of the market expectation of the price of the underlying asset. Even though the expectation in principle may be recovered by adjusting the futures price by the estimated risk premium, a common problem in applied work is that there are as many measures of market expectations as there are estimates of the risk premium. We propose a general solution to this problem that allows us to uniquely pin down the best possible estimate of the market expectation for any set of risk premium estimates. We illustrate this approach by solving the long-standing problem of how to recover the market expectation of the price of crude oil. We provide a new measure of oil price expectations that is considerably more accurate than the alternatives and more economically plausible. We discuss implications of our analysis for the estimation of economic models of energy-intensive durables, for the debate on speculation in oil markets, and for oil price forecasting.
abstract_zh: 期货市场是有关市场预期的一个潜在有价值的信息来源。在实践中，利用这一信息一直十分困难，因为时变风险溢价的存在往往使期货价格成为标的资产价格市场预期的一个糟糕度量。尽管原则上可以通过用估计的风险溢价调整期货价格来恢复预期，但应用研究中的一个普遍问题是，市场预期的度量数量与风险溢价估计的数量一样多。我们提出了一个解决该问题的一般方法，使我们能够针对任何一组风险溢价估计唯一地确定市场预期的最佳估计。我们以恢复原油价格市场预期这一长期存在的难题为例说明了该方法。我们提供了一种新的油价预期度量，其准确性显著高于其他替代方案，且在经济上更为合理。我们还讨论了本文分析对能源密集型耐用品经济模型估计的启示，对石油市场投机争论的启示，以及对油价预测的启示。

title: Did the Renewable Fuel Standard Shift Market Expectations of the Price of Ethanol?
abstract: It is commonly believed that the response of the price of corn ethanol (and hence of the price of corn) to shifts in biofuel policies operates in part through market expectations and shifts in storage demand, yet to date it has proved difficult to measure these expectations and to empirically evaluate this view. We quantify the extent to which price changes were anticipated by the market, the extent to which they were unanticipated, and how the risk premium in these markets has evolved. We show that the Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) increased ethanol price expectations by as much $1.50 initially, raising ethanol storage demand starting and causing an increase in the price of ethanol. There is no conclusive evidence that the tightening of the RFS in 2008 shifted market expectations, but our analysis suggests that policy uncertainty about how to deal with the blend wall raised the risk premium in the ethanol futures market in mid-2013 by as much as 50 cents at longer horizons. Finally, we present evidence against a tight link from ethanol price expectations to corn price expectations and hence to the storage demand for corn in 2005-06.
abstract_zh: 人们普遍认为，玉米乙醇价格（进而玉米价格）对生物燃料政策变化的反应，部分是通过市场预期和储存需求的变动实现的，然而迄今为止，要衡量这些预期并对该观点进行经验检验一直十分困难。我们量化了价格变动在多大程度上被市场预期到、在多大程度上未被预期到，以及这些市场的风险溢价如何演变。我们发现，可再生燃料标准（Renewable Fuel Standard，RFS）最初使乙醇价格预期提高了多达1.50美元，从而提高了乙醇的储存需求，并导致乙醇价格上涨。没有确凿证据表明2008年RFS的收紧改变了市场预期，但我们的分析表明，关于如何应对“混合墙”（blend wall）的政策不确定性，使2013年年中乙醇期货市场的风险溢价在较长期限上提高了多达50美分。最后，我们提供的证据表明，乙醇价格预期与玉米价格预期之间并无紧密联系，因而在2005年至2006年间，乙醇价格预期对玉米储存需求的影响也十分有限。

title: Liquidity, Inflation and Asset Prices in a Time-Varying Framework for the Euro Area
venue: National Bank of Belgium Working Paper

title: Risky Oil: It's All in the Tails
abstract: The substantial fluctuations in oil prices in the wake of COVID-19 and the Russian invasion of Ukraine have highlighted the importance of tail events in the global oil market, which call for careful risk assessment. Using a new set of predictor variables that capture various sources of risk, we show that a machine learning approach delivers the most accurate tail forecasts for the real price of oil. We quantify the role of economic determinants for upside and downside oil price risks and illustrate the practical relevance of our new approach by tracking the evolution of predictive densities during three recent economic and geopolitical crisis episodes and by developing producer and consumer distress indices.
abstract_zh: 新冠疫情和俄罗斯入侵乌克兰之后，油价的大幅波动凸显了全球石油市场中尾部事件的重要性，这需要审慎的风险评估。利用一组捕捉多种风险来源的新预测变量，我们表明，机器学习方法能够给出对实际油价最为准确的尾部预测。我们量化了经济决定因素对油价上行和下行风险的作用，并通过追踪近期三次经济和地缘政治危机期间预测密度的演变，以及构建生产者和消费者困境指数，说明了我们新方法的实际相关性。

title: Structural Interpretation of Vector Autoregressions with Incomplete Identification: Setting the Record Straight
Uncovering Disaggregated Oil Market Dynamics: A Full-Information Approach to Granular Instrumental Variables
abstract: The world price of oil is determined by the interactions of multiple producers and consumers who face different constraints and shocks. We show how this feature of the oil market can be used to estimate local and global elasticities of supply and demand and provide a rich set of testable restrictions. We develop a novel approach to estimation based on full-information maximum likelihood that generalizes the insights from granular instrumental variables. We conclude that the supply responses of Saudi Arabia and adjustments of inventories have historically played a key role in stabilizing the price of oil. We illustrate how our structural model can be used to analyze how individual producers and consumers would dynamically adapt to a geopolitical event such as a major disruption in the supply of oil from Russia.
abstract_zh: 世界油价由面临不同约束和冲击的多个生产者与消费者之间的相互作用所决定。我们表明，石油市场的这一特征可用于估计局部和全球的供给与需求弹性，并提供一套丰富的可检验约束条件。我们提出了一种基于完全信息最大似然的新估计方法，该方法推广了粒度工具变量（granular instrumental variables）的思路。我们的结论是，沙特阿拉伯的供给响应以及库存调整，在历史上对稳定油价发挥了关键作用。我们还说明了如何利用我们的结构模型，分析个别生产者和消费者会如何动态地适应地缘政治事件，例如俄罗斯石油供应的重大中断。

title: Advances in Using Vector Autoregressions to Estimate Structural Magnitudes
Tracking Weekly State-Level Economic Conditions
Measuring Market Expectations
Energy Markets and Global Economic Conditions
abstract: This paper evaluates alternative indicators of global economic activity and other market fundamentals in terms of their usefulness for forecasting real oil prices and global petroleum consumption. We find that world industrial production is one of the most useful indicators that has been proposed in the literature. However, by combining measures from a number of different sources we can do even better. Our analysis results in a new index of global economic conditions and new measures for assessing future tightness of energy demand and expected oil price pressures.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了全球经济活动的各类替代性指标以及其他市场基本面，考察其在预测实际油价和全球石油消费方面的有用性。我们发现，世界工业生产是文献中所提出的最有用的指标之一。然而，通过综合多个不同来源的度量，我们可以做得更好。我们的分析得出了一个新的全球经济状况指数，以及用于评估未来能源需求紧张程度和预期油价压力的新度量。

title: Structural Vector Autoregressions with Imperfect Identifying Information
A Comparison of Monthly Global Indicators for Forecasting Growth
Drawing Conclusions from Structural Vector Autoregressions Identified on the Basis of Sign Restrictions
venue: Journal of International Money and Finance

title: Structural Interpretation of Vector Autoregressions with Incomplete Identification: Revisiting the Role of Oil Supply and Demand Shocks
abstract: Traditional approaches to structural vector autoregressions (VARs) can be viewed as special cases of Bayesian inference arising from very strong prior beliefs. These methods can be generalized with a less restrictive formulation that incorporates uncertainty about the identifying assumptions themselves. We use this approach to revisit the importance of shocks to oil supply and demand. Supply disruptions turn out to be a bigger factor in historical oil price movements and inventory accumulation a smaller factor than implied by earlier estimates. Supply shocks lead to a reduction in global economic activity after a significant lag, whereas shocks to oil demand do not. (JEL C32, L71, Q35, Q43)
abstract_zh: 传统的结构向量自回归（VAR）方法可以被视为源于非常强的先验信念的贝叶斯推断的特例。通过纳入对识别假设本身不确定性的、限制性较弱的表述，这些方法可以得到推广。我们运用这一方法重新考察了石油供给冲击与需求冲击的重要性。结果显示，供给中断在历史油价波动中的作用比早期估计所暗示的更大，而在库存积累中的作用则更小。供给冲击在经过较长滞后后会导致全球经济活动下降，而石油需求冲击则不会。（JEL分类号：C32、L71、Q35、Q43）

title: Are Product Spreads Useful for Forecasting Oil Prices? An Empirical Evaluation of the Verleger Hypothesis
abstract: Many oil industry analysts believe that there is predictive power in the product spread, defined as the difference between suitably weighted refined product market prices and the price of crude oil. We derive a number of alternative forecasting model specifications based on product spreads and compare the implied forecasts to the no-change forecast of the real price of oil. We show that not all product spread models are useful for out-of-sample forecasting, but some models are, even at horizons between one and two years. The most accurate model is a time-varying parameter model of gasoline and heating oil spot price spreads that allows for structural change in product markets. We document mean-squared prediction error reductions as high as 20% and directional accuracy as high as 63% at the two-year horizon, making product spread models a good complement to forecasting models based on economic fundamentals, which work best at short horizons.
abstract_zh: 许多石油行业分析师认为，产品价差具有预测能力。产品价差定义为经适当加权的成品油市场价格与原油价格之差。我们推导出若干基于产品价差的替代性预测模型设定，并将其隐含预测与实际油价的不变预测（no-change forecast）进行比较。我们表明，并非所有产品价差模型都对样本外预测有用，但有些模型是有用的，甚至在一至两年的预测期限上也是如此。最准确的模型是汽油和取暖油现货价差的时变参数模型，该模型允许产品市场存在结构性变化。我们记录了在两年期限上高达20%的均方预测误差降低，以及高达63%的方向准确率，这使得产品价差模型成为基于经济基本面的预测模型的良好补充，后者在短期预测中表现最好。

title: Inference in Structural Vector Autoregressions When the Identifying Assumptions are Not Fully Believed: Re-evaluating the Role of Monetary Policy in Economic Fluctuations
Is the Discretionary Income Effect of Oil Price Shocks a Hoax?
abstract: The transmission of oil price shocks has been a question of central interest in macroeconomics since the 1970s. There has been renewed interest in this question since the large and persistent fall in the real price of oil in 2014-16. In the context of this debate, Ramey (2017) makes the striking claim that the existing literature on the transmission of oil price shocks is fundamentally confused about the question of how to quantify the effect of oil price shocks. In particular, she asserts that the discretionary income effect on private consumption, which plays a central role in contemporary accounts of the transmission of oil price shocks to the U.S. economy, makes no economic sense and has no economic foundation. Ramey suggests that the literature has too often confused the terms-of-trade effect with this discretionary income effect, and she makes the case that the effects of the oil price decline of 2014-16 on private consumption are smaller for a multitude of reasons than suggested by empirical models of the discretionary income effect. We review the main arguments in Ramey (2017) and show that none of her claims hold up to scrutiny. Our analysis highlights the theoretical basis of the discretionary income effect. We also discuss improved regression-based estimates of this effect that allow for changes in the dependence on oil and gasoline imports, and we highlight the fact that alternative estimates used by policymakers involve strong simplifying assumptions.
abstract_zh: 自20世纪70年代以来，油价冲击的传导一直是宏观经济学中的核心问题。自2014年至2016年实际油价大幅且持续下跌以来，该问题再次引起广泛关注。在这一争论的背景下，Ramey（2017）提出了一个引人注目的论断：现有关于油价冲击传导的文献在如何量化油价冲击效应这一问题上存在根本性的混淆。具体而言，她断言，可自由支配收入效应（discretionary income effect）对私人消费的影响在当代关于油价冲击如何传导至美国经济的解释中居于核心地位，但这种效应毫无经济意义，也缺乏经济学基础。Ramey认为，文献常常将贸易条件效应与这种可自由支配收入效应相混淆，并且她认为，2014年至2016年油价下跌对私人消费的影响，由于多种原因，要小于实证模型所暗示的程度。我们回顾了Ramey（2017）的主要论点，并表明她的所有论断都经不起推敲。我们的分析凸显了可自由支配收入效应的理论基础。我们还讨论了改进的基于回归的估计，这些估计允许对石油和汽油进口依赖度的变化进行调整，并且我们强调，政策制定者所使用的其他估计方法依赖于强烈的简化假设。

title: Inside the Crystal Ball: New Approaches to Predicting the Gasoline Price at the Pump
abstract: Although there is much interest in the future retail price of gasoline among consumers, industry analysts, and policymakers, it is widely believed that changes in the price of gasoline are essentially unforecastable given publicly available information. We explore a range of new forecasting approaches for the retail price of gasoline and compare their accuracy with the no-change forecast. Our key finding is that substantial reductions in the mean-squared prediction error (MSPE) of gasoline price forecasts are feasible in real time at horizons up to two years, as are substantial increases in directional accuracy. The most accurate individual model is a VAR(1) model for real retail gasoline and Brent crude oil prices. Even greater reductions in MSPEs are possible by constructing a pooled forecast that assigns equal weight to five of the most successful forecasting models. Pooled forecasts have lower MSPE than the EIA gasoline price forecasts and the gasoline price expectations in the Michigan Survey of Consumers. We also show that as much as 39% of the decline in gas prices between June and December 2014 was predictable.
abstract_zh: 尽管消费者、行业分析师和政策制定者都非常关注零售汽油的未来价格，但人们普遍认为，在公开可得的信息条件下，汽油价格的变化基本上是无法预测的。我们探索了一系列针对零售汽油价格的新预测方法，并将其准确性与不变预测进行比较。我们的核心发现是，在实时条件下，对于长达两年的预测期限，汽油价格预测的均方预测误差（MSPE）可以大幅降低，方向准确率也可以大幅提高。表现最准确的单一模型是针对实际零售汽油价格和布伦特原油价格的VAR(1)模型。通过构建一个对五个表现最成功的预测模型赋予相同权重的合成预测，还可以实现更大的均方预测误差降低。合成预测的均方预测误差低于美国能源信息署（EIA）的汽油价格预测，也低于密歇根消费者调查中的汽油价格预期。我们还表明，在2014年6月至12月期间，汽油价格下跌幅度中多达39%是可以预测的。

title: Forty Years of Oil Price Fluctuations: Why the Price of Oil May Still Surprise Us
abstract: It has been forty years since the oil crisis of 1973/74. This crisis has been one of the defining economic events of the 1970s and has shaped how many economists think about oil price shocks. In recent years, a large literature on the economic determinants of oil price fluctuations has emerged. Drawing on this literature, we first provide an overview of the causes of all major oil price fluctuations between 1973 and 2014. We then discuss why oil price fluctuations remain difficult to predict, despite economists’ improved understanding of oil markets. Unexpected oil price fluctuations are commonly referred to as oil price shocks. We document that, in practice, consumers, policymakers, financial market participants and economists may have different oil price expectations, and that, what may be surprising to some, need not be equally surprising to others.
abstract_zh: 1973/74年的石油危机距今已有四十年。这场危机是20世纪70年代最具决定性的经济事件之一，并塑造了许多经济学家对油价冲击的理解。近年来，关于油价波动经济决定因素的文献大量涌现。基于这些文献，我们首先概述了1973年至2014年间所有主要油价波动的成因。随后，我们讨论了尽管经济学家对石油市场的理解有所提高，油价波动为何仍然难以预测。非预期的油价波动通常被称为油价冲击。我们记录到，在实践中，消费者、政策制定者、金融市场参与者和经济学家可能持有不同的油价预期，而对于某些人而言是出乎意料的事情，对于其他人未必同样出乎意料。

title: Lower Oil Prices and the U.S. Economy: Is This Time Different?
abstract: We explore the effect on U.S. real GDP growth of the sharp and sustained decline in the global price of crude oil and hence in the U.S. price of gasoline after June 2014. Our analysis suggests that this decline produced a cumulative stimulus of about 0.9 percentage points of real GDP growth by raising private real consumption and non-oil related business investment and an additional stimulus of 0.04 percentage points reflecting a shrinking petroleum trade deficit. This stimulating effect, however, has been largely offset by a large reduction in real investment by the oil sector. Hence, the net stimulus since June 2014 has been close to zero. We show that the response of the U.S. economy was not fundamentally different from that observed after the oil price decline of 1986. Then as now the response of the U.S. economy is consistent with standard economic models of the transmission of oil price shocks. We found no evidence of an additional role for frictions in reallocating labor across sectors or for increased uncertainty about the price of gasoline in explaining the sluggish response of U.S. real GDP growth. Nor did we find evidence of financial contagion, of spillovers from oil-related investment to non-oil related investment, of an increase in household savings, or of households deleveraging.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了2014年6月之后全球原油价格，进而美国汽油价格急剧且持续下跌，对美国实际GDP增长的影响。我们的分析表明，这一下跌通过提高私人实际消费和非石油相关企业投资，产生了约0.9个百分点的累积性实际GDP增长刺激，并且由于石油贸易逆差缩小，又带来了0.04个百分点的额外刺激。然而，石油部门实际投资的大幅下降在很大程度上抵消了这一刺激效应。因此，自2014年6月以来，净刺激效应接近于零。我们表明，美国经济的反应与1986年油价下跌后观察到的反应并无根本不同。当时与现在一样，美国经济的反应都符合油价冲击传导的标准经济模型。在解释美国实际GDP增长的乏力反应方面，我们没有发现劳动力跨部门再配置摩擦的额外作用，也没有发现汽油价格不确定性增加的作用。我们也没有发现金融传染、石油相关投资向非石油相关投资溢出、家庭储蓄增加或家庭去杠杆化的证据。

title: Understanding the Decline in the Price of Oil since June 2014
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Some observers have conjectured that oil supply shocks in the United States and in other countries are behind the plunge in the price of oil since June 2014. Others have suggested that a major shock to oil price expectations occurred when in late November 2014 OPEC announced that it would maintain current production levels despite the steady increase in non-OPEC oil production. Both conjectures are perfectly reasonable ex ante, yet we provide quantitative evidence that neither explanation appears supported by the data. We show that more than half of the decline in the price of oil was predictable in real time as of June 2014 and therefore must have reflected the cumulative effects of earlier oil demand and supply shocks. Among the shocks that occurred after June 2014, the most influential shock resembles a negative shock to the demand for oil associated with a weakening economy in December 2014. In contrast, there is no evidence of any large positive oil supply shocks between June and December. We conclude that the difference in the evolution of the price of oil, which declined by 44% over this period, compared with other commodity prices, which on average only declined by about 5%-15%, reflects oil-market specific developments that took place prior to June 2014.
abstract_zh: 一些观察者推测，美国及其他国家的石油供给冲击是2014年6月以来油价暴跌的原因。另一些人则认为，2014年11月下旬欧佩克宣布在非欧佩克石油产量持续稳步增长的情况下维持现有产量水平，这一事件对油价预期造成了重大冲击。这两种猜想在事前看来都颇为合理，但我们提供的定量证据表明，这两种解释似乎都没有得到数据的支持。我们表明，油价跌幅中超过一半在2014年6月的实时条件下即可预测，因此必定反映了早前石油需求和供给冲击的累积效应。在2014年6月之后发生的冲击中，影响最大的冲击类似于与2014年12月经济疲软相关的负向石油需求冲击。相反，在6月至12月期间，没有任何大的正向石油供给冲击的证据。我们的结论是，油价在此期间下跌了44%，而其他大宗商品价格平均仅下跌约5%至15%，这种差异反映的是2014年6月之前已经发生的石油市场特有的发展。

title: Do High-Frequency Financial Data Help Forecast Oil Prices? The MIDAS Touch at Work
Forecasting the Real Price of Oil in a Changing World: A Forecast Combination Approach
venue: Journal of Business and Economic Statistics
abstract: The U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) regularly publishes monthly and quarterly forecasts of the price of crude oil for horizons up to 2 years, which are widely used by practitioners. Traditionally, such out-of-sample forecasts have been largely judgmental, making them difficult to replicate and justify. An alternative is the use of real-time econometric oil price forecasting models. We investigate the merits of constructing combinations of six such models. Forecast combinations have received little attention in the oil price forecasting literature to date. We demonstrate that over the last 20 years suitably constructed real-time forecast combinations would have been systematically more accurate than the no-change forecast at horizons up to 6 quarters or 18 months. The MSPE reductions may be as high as 12% and directional accuracy as high as 72%. The gains in accuracy are robust over time. In contrast, the EIA oil price forecasts not only tend to be less accurate than no-change forecasts, but are much less accurate than our preferred forecast combination. Moreover, including EIA forecasts in the forecast combination systematically lowers the accuracy of the combination forecast. We conclude that suitably constructed forecast combinations should replace traditional judgmental forecasts of the price of oil.
abstract_zh: 美国能源信息署（EIA）定期发布油价的月度和季度预测，预测期限可达两年，这些预测被业界广泛使用。传统上，此类样本外预测在很大程度上依赖判断，因此难以复现和论证。另一种方法是使用实时计量经济油价预测模型。我们研究了构建六个此类模型组合的优点。迄今为止，预测组合在油价预测文献中很少受到关注。我们证明，在过去20年间，经过适当构建的实时预测组合在长达6个季度或18个月的预测期限内，系统性地比不变预测更准确。均方预测误差的降低可能高达12%，方向准确率可高达72%。这种准确性的提高在不同时期均具有稳健性。相比之下，EIA的油价预测不仅往往比不变预测更不准确，而且远不及我们偏好的预测组合准确。此外，将EIA预测纳入预测组合会系统性地降低组合预测的准确性。我们的结论是，经过适当构建的预测组合应当取代传统的油价判断性预测。

title: Sign Restrictions, Structural Vector Autoregressions, and Useful Prior Information
Are There Gains from Pooling Real-Time Oil Price Forecasts?
Do Oil Price Increases Cause Higher Food Prices?
Real-Time Analysis of Oil Price Risks Using Forecast Scenarios
What Central Bankers Need to Know about Forecasting Oil Prices
abstract: Central banks routinely use short-horizon forecasts of the quarterly price of oil in assessing the global and domestic economic outlook. We address a number of econometric issues specific to the construction of quarterly oil price forecasts in the United States and abroad. We show that quarterly forecasts of the real price of oil from suitably designed vector autoregressive models estimated on monthly data generate the most accurate real-time forecasts overall among a wide range of methods, including quarterly averages of forecasts based on monthly oil futures prices, no-change forecasts, and forecasts based on regression models estimated on quarterly data.
abstract_zh: 中央银行在评估全球和国内经济前景时，常规性地使用季度油价的短期预测。我们讨论了美国及其他国家构建季度油价预测所特有的若干计量经济学问题。我们表明，基于月度数据估计的、经适当设计的向量自回归模型所给出的季度实际油价预测，在一系列方法中总体上能够生成最准确的实时预测，这些方法包括基于月度石油期货价格的预测的季度平均值、不变预测，以及基于季度数据估计的回归模型所给出的预测。

title: Changes in the Effects of Monetary Policy on Disaggregate Price Dynamics
venue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control

title: The Role of Time-Varying Price Elasticities in Accounting for Volatility Changes in the Crude Oil Market
Time-Varying Effects of Oil Supply Shocks on the US Economy
abstract: We investigate how the dynamic effects of oil supply shocks on the US economy have changed over time. We first document a remarkable structural change in the oil market itself, i.e. a considerably steeper, hence, less elastic oil demand curve since the mid-eighties. Accordingly, a typical oil supply shock is currently characterized by a much smaller impact on world oil production and a greater effect on the real price of crude oil, but has a similar impact on US output and inflation as in the 1970s. Second, we find a smaller role for oil supply shocks in accounting for real oil price variability over time, implying that current oil price fluctuations are more demand driven. Finally, while unfavorable oil supply disturbances explain little of the "Great Inflation", they seem to have contributed to the 1974/75, early 1980s and 1990s recessions but also dampened the economic boom at the end of the millennium.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了石油供给冲击对美国经济的动态效应如何随时间变化。我们首先记录了石油市场本身发生的一项显著结构性变化，即自20世纪80年代中期以来，石油需求曲线变得更为陡峭，因而弹性更小。因此，目前一次典型的石油供给冲击对世界石油产量的影响要小得多，而对实际原油价格的影响则更大，但其对美国产出和通货膨胀的影响与20世纪70年代相似。其次，我们发现石油供给冲击在解释实际油价随时间变化方面的作用变小了，这意味着当前的油价波动更多是由需求驱动的。最后，尽管不利的石油供给扰动难以解释“大通胀”（Great Inflation），但它们似乎促成了1974/75年、20世纪80年代初期和90年代的经济衰退，同时也抑制了千禧年之交的经济繁荣。

title: Unconventional Monetary Policy and the Great Recession: Estimating the Macroeconomic Effects of a Spread Compression at the Zero Lower Bound
Real-Time Forecasts of the Real Price of Oil
venue: Journal of Business and Economic Statistics
abstract: We construct a monthly real-time dataset consisting of vintages for 1991.1–2010.12 that is suitable for generating forecasts of the real price of oil from a variety of models. We document that revisions of the data typically represent news, and we introduce backcasting and nowcasting techniques to fill gaps in the real-time data. We show that real-time forecasts of the real price of oil can be more accurate than the no-change forecast at horizons up to 1 year. In some cases, real-time mean squared prediction error (MSPE) reductions may be as high as 25% 1 month ahead and 24% 3 months ahead. This result is in striking contrast to related results in the literature for asset prices. In particular, recursive vector autoregressive (VAR) forecasts based on global oil market variables tend to have lower MSPE at short horizons than forecasts based on oil futures prices, forecasts based on autoregressive (AR) and autoregressive moving average (ARMA) models, and the no-change forecast. In addition, these VAR models have consistently higher directional accuracy.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个月度实时数据集，包含1991年1月至2010年12月的历史版本，适用于利用多种模型生成实际油价预测。我们记录到，数据的修订通常代表新信息，并且我们引入了回溯预测（backcasting）和即时预测（nowcasting）技术来填补实时数据中的缺口。我们表明，在长达1年的预测期限内，实际油价的实时预测可以比不变预测更准确。在某些情况下，实时均方预测误差（MSPE）在提前1个月时可降低多达25%，在提前3个月时可降低24%。这一结果与文献中关于资产价格的相关结论形成了鲜明对比。具体而言，基于全球石油市场变量的递归向量自回归（VAR）预测，在短期预测中往往比基于石油期货价格的预测、基于自回归（AR）和自回归移动平均（ARMA）模型的预测以及不变预测具有更低的均方预测误差。此外，这些VAR模型的方向准确率始终更高。

title: The Economic Consequences of Oil Shocks: Differences across Countries and Time
venue: Inflation in an Era of Relative Price Shocks
